main_idea: Simple prompts cut clutter to near zero across models, versus raw prompts.
ideas: Simple prompts cut clutter to almost nothing
Raw prompts leave high clutter in every model
GPT-6 Luna still has some clutter under simple prompts
summary: Clutter is limited to an eyebrow, two takeaway cards restating the chart, and a repeated footer wordmark around a clear, complete bar chart.
